acceptanceCriteria: Retain immutable Git reproductions for an empty file created or deleted and a mode-only change.

Per decision 0546 §4, cem/1.0 refuses such a diff with an explicit typed code naming the path and the kind of change, without inventing a text hunk, relabelling 0.x packets or changing the frozen cem/1.0 bytes.
Native and portable conformance covers the refusal for each kind, including a mixed text/metadata diff. Versioned metadata representation is deferred past 1.0 to a follow-up ticket.
body: Confirmed capability limit, not invented report corruption: installed Corvint1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and current reviewed source62042ed3011887e8dac7b03acd2dbabdf1ad76fe refuse canonical CEM preparation for BASE122736130aa6c2810e1dae07317036295f1c7475 with malformed-patch: expected --- file header. Eleven actual zero-byte SQL/Swift report files have native Git new-file metadata with no text hunk. Current0.2 closed grammar requires file headers; preserve refusal until an accepted metadata-capable contract is qualified. Evidence /private/tmp/cem10-delivery-build/cem-prepare-diagnosis.json and source-dogfood-prepare.log. Task-owned fixture packaging repair retains explicit exact empty bytes+SHA without changing production wire/parser or nonempty native reports. Remaining product work: explicitly represent or abstain for empty-file creation/deletion/mode-only metadata in CEM1.0, independently across native/portable consumers.
title: CEM canonical binding refuses metadata-only empty native report fixture additions
